concerns.text: Task T009 (IRB/Consent verification) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on the output of T008 (dataset discovery) to check metadata. It cannot run in parallel with T008 as it requires the 'found' dataset list to verify consent URLs. This violates the [P] tag and the 'Producer before Consumer' rule.

Task T011 (Fallback logic) is marked [P] but depends on the outputs of T009 (IRB check) and T010 (Synthetic generator). It cannot run in parallel with T009 or T010 as it consumes their results to decide the data path. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T013a (Pre-Imputation Variable Check) is marked [P] but explicitly states 'DEPENDS ON T012'. It cannot run in parallel with T012 (Data Loader) as it requires the loaded data to verify variables. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T013b (Post-Imputation Validation) is marked [P] but explicitly states 'DEPENDS ON T016'. It cannot run in parallel with T016 (Missing Data Handling) as it requires the imputed data to validate. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T017 (Variable normalization & change scores) is marked [P] but depends on T013a and T016. It cannot run in parallel with these tasks as it requires the pre-validated and imputed data. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T018 (ANCOVA regression) is marked [P] but depends on T013a and T016. It cannot run in parallel with these tasks as it requires the processed data. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T020 (Dynamic interpretation) is marked [P] but depends on T019. It cannot run in parallel with T019 (Assumption validation) as it requires the validation results. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T026 (CI width variance calculation) is marked [P] but depends on T025. It cannot run in parallel with T025 (Bootstrap resampling) as it requires the bootstrap results. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T028 (Threshold sensitivity sweep) is marked [P] but depends on T013a. It cannot run in parallel with T013a as it requires the pre-validated data. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T029 (Family-wise error correction) is marked [P] but depends on T028. It cannot run in parallel with T028 as it requires the sensitivity sweep results. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T030 (Final report generation) is marked [P] but depends on T029. It cannot run in parallel with T029 as it requires the sensitivity findings. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T032b (Black formatting) is marked [P] but explicitly states 'DEPENDS ON T032a'. It cannot run in parallel with T032a (Flake8) as it requires the code to be linted first (or at least, the task description implies a sequential dependency). The [P] tag is incorrect.

Tasks T047, T048, and T049 (Unit tests for data integrity) are marked [P] but depend on the implementation of T036, T009/T044, and T013a/T039 respectively. While tests can be written in parallel with implementation, the task descriptions imply they verify specific logic that must exist. More critically, T047 depends on T036 being implemented to test the `DataFetchError`. If T036 is not yet implemented, T047 cannot be executed. The [P] tag is misleading if it implies these can run independently of the implementation tasks they test.
